│ Make a character: a name and a class.                                        │
│                                                                              │
│ Name   zEDD_               3 to 16 letters                                   │
│                                                                              │
│ Class (the server's menu)                                                    │
│   1  Warrior   tank                                                          │
│ > 2  Cleric    healer                                                        │
│   3  Rogue     melee                                                         │
│   4  Wizard    spell                                                         │
│   5  Paladin   tank + healer                                                 │
│   6  Druid     healer + spell                                                │
│                                                                              │
│ Healer who mends wounds and wards allies, with a hallowed blow of their own. │
│ Starts with, free:                                                           │
│   Minor Heal (1.5 s cast, 10 mana, range 25m, ally)                          │
│   Smite (1.5 s cast, cd 6s, 8 mana, range 25m, enemy)                        │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ ! someone already has that name (name_taken)                                 │
│ Type the name. Tab or Down moves to the classes: Up / Down or 1-6 choose.    │
│ Enter makes the character and plays it. Ctrl+C quits.                        │
